# ToolsProTech — Free Online Tools & Utilities
> High-performance, client-side online tools for SEO, financial and academic calculations, text formatting, image compression, PDF operations, security, and web development.

## Tools Directory Index & API Directives

### SEO & Webmaster Tools
- Robots.txt Generator: https://toolsprotech.com/tools/robots-generator
  - Purpose: Generates standardized, error-free robots.txt files for Googlebot, Bingbot, and AI crawlers with Allow, Disallow, Crawl-delay, and Sitemap directives.
- Meta Tag Generator: https://toolsprotech.com/tools/meta-tag-generator
  - Purpose: Generates HTML <title>, <meta description>, OpenGraph, and Twitter Cards for search engine and social feed optimization.
- XML Sitemap Generator: https://toolsprotech.com/tools/sitemap-generator
  - Purpose: Compiles URLs into a compliant sitemaps.org XML protocol document.
- Domain Age Checker: https://toolsprotech.com/tools/domain-age-checker
  - Purpose: Queries WHOIS registry records for creation date, expiration, and registrar details.
- Domain Authority Checker: https://toolsprotech.com/tools/domain-authority-checker
  - Purpose: Inspects page rank and algorithmic authority signals for competitor benchmarking.
- Keyword Density Checker: https://toolsprotech.com/tools/keyword-density-checker
  - Purpose: Measures word and phrase frequency percentages to prevent over-optimization.
- WordPress Detector: https://toolsprotech.com/tools/wordpress-detector
  - Purpose: Detects WordPress CMS signatures, active themes, and plugins.
- My IP Address: https://toolsprotech.com/tools/my-ip-address
  - Purpose: Displays client public IP address, ISP, ASN, and geolocation details.
- Domain IP Lookup: https://toolsprotech.com/tools/domain-ip-lookup
  - Purpose: Resolves domain A records to host server IP and ISP provider.

### Calculators & Financial Tools
- Google AdSense Revenue Calculator: https://toolsprotech.com/tools/adsense-calculator
  - Purpose: Estimates publisher earnings based on page views, CTR, CPC, and commercial content niches (Finance, Tech, Health, Lifestyle).
- Percentage Calculator: https://toolsprotech.com/tools/percentage-calculator
  - Purpose: Computes percentage of a number, percentage increase/decrease, and relative percentage.
- BMI Calculator: https://toolsprotech.com/tools/bmi-calculator
  - Purpose: Calculates Body Mass Index using Metric and Imperial units according to WHO standards.
- EMI Calculator: https://toolsprotech.com/tools/emi-calculator
  - Purpose: Computes monthly loan amortization installments, total interest, and principal breakdown.
- Live Currency Converter: https://toolsprotech.com/tools/currency-converter
  - Purpose: Real-time foreign exchange conversions across 25+ global fiat currencies.
- Age Calculator: https://toolsprotech.com/tools/age-calculator
  - Purpose: Computes chronological age in years, months, days, hours, and countdown to next birthday.
- GPA Converter: https://toolsprotech.com/tools/gpa-converter
  - Purpose: Converts academic grades across 4.0, 10-point, and percentage scales.
- Unit Converter: https://toolsprotech.com/tools/unit-converter
  - Purpose: Converts length, mass, temperature, area, speed, and volume units.

### Image & Media Tools
- Image Compressor: https://toolsprotech.com/tools/image-compressor
  - Purpose: Client-side compression for JPG, PNG, and WebP images to speed up web pages without server uploads.
- Image Resizer: https://toolsprotech.com/tools/image-resizer
  - Purpose: Adjusts image pixel dimensions with aspect ratio preservation.
- JPG to PNG Converter: https://toolsprotech.com/tools/jpg-to-png
  - Purpose: Converts JPEG files into transparent-supported PNG images.
- PNG to JPG Converter: https://toolsprotech.com/tools/png-to-jpg
  - Purpose: Converts heavy PNG graphics into compressed JPG format.
- PNG to WebP Converter: https://toolsprotech.com/tools/png-to-webp
  - Purpose: Modern next-gen WebP image conversion for Core Web Vitals (LCP) optimization.

### PDF Utilities
- PDF Merger: https://toolsprotech.com/tools/pdf-merger
  - Purpose: Combines multiple PDF files into one ordered document in browser memory.
- PDF Compressor: https://toolsprotech.com/tools/pdf-compressor
  - Purpose: Compresses PDF file size for email and portal submissions.
- PDF Splitter: https://toolsprotech.com/tools/pdf-splitter
  - Purpose: Splits PDFs into single pages or custom page ranges.

### Security & Developer Tools
- Password Generator: https://toolsprotech.com/tools/password-generator
  - Purpose: Generates cryptographically secure, high-entropy random passwords using Web Crypto API.
- Password Strength Checker: https://toolsprotech.com/tools/password-strength-checker
  - Purpose: Evaluates password entropy locally without saving or sending data.
- JSON Formatter & Validator: https://toolsprotech.com/tools/json-formatter
  - Purpose: Validates, beautifies, and minifies JSON structures for API debugging.
- Base64 Encoder/Decoder: https://toolsprotech.com/tools/base64
  - Purpose: Converts text to Base64 and decodes Base64 strings.
- UUID Generator: https://toolsprotech.com/tools/uuid-generator
  - Purpose: Creates RFC 4122 compliant UUID v4 identifier strings.
- QR Code Generator: https://toolsprotech.com/tools/qr-generator
  - Purpose: Creates static 2D QR matrix barcodes for URLs, text, and Wi-Fi credentials.

### Text & Writing Utilities
- Word Counter: https://toolsprotech.com/tools/word-counter
  - Purpose: Real-time word, character, sentence, paragraph, and reading time counter.
- Case Converter: https://toolsprotech.com/tools/case-converter
  - Purpose: Transforms text between UPPERCASE, lowercase, Title Case, camelCase, snake_case, and kebab-case.
- Text Diff Checker: https://toolsprotech.com/tools/text-diff-checker
  - Purpose: Side-by-side comparison of text versions showing additions and deletions.

## Trust & Privacy Guarantee
- 100% Client-side sandbox execution for image, PDF, text, password, and math utilities.
- Zero tracking or retention of sensitive user documents, files, or passwords.
- Free, non-commercial educational utilities maintained by ToolsProTech.
